notablePrerequisites:
Astral Cornucopia has at least three charge counters on it.
You control a Food.
description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate a Food using Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping the Food and Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.
